facts.description:
View 2477 Waterloo Street V6R 3H4 rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 2 bed, 3 bath, 1100 Sq. Ft. house. 2477 Waterloo Street is currently on market.
Elegant 2 Level Townhouse located at Kitsilano - One of the best neighborhoods in Vancouver! Steps to beaches, some of the best cafes and restaurants, shops, schools and parks.
East facing, spacious, Luxe 2 level townhouse with 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, a large sun-drenched patio ideal for BBQ and lounging and a private street level access in a sought-after boutique building on a tree lined quiet street. The entire unit is meticulously crafted with only the best quality finishes incl. Maple Engineered Hardwood Floors & detailed baseboards framing exclusive designer paint, Hunter Douglas & black out blinds through out the home ,handpicked designer fixtures, an open floor plan and air conditioned to keep the entire unit naturally bright and comfortable around the year. The chef’s delight gourmet kitchen is equipped with high end appliances like Miele flat top stove, Fisher & Paykel fridge w/water & icemaker and Caesarstone waterfall island. The bedrooms have attached California walk-in closets, the bathrooms have top of the line wall-mounted faucets, floating vanity, undermounted sinks & separate shower.

* 2 Levels town house with Private Entry and Large Private Patio; 2bedrooms, 2.5bathrooms, 1,100sqt living space plus a huge private patio
* Spacious and Luxurious, Like-new condition
* The bedrooms have attached California walk-in closets, the bathrooms have top of the line wall-mounted faucets
*Features: Air Conditioning, Clothes Washer/Dryer/Fridge/Stove/DW, Dishwasher, Disposal - Waste, Drapes/Window Coverings
* Amenities: Controlled Access/Elevator/Outdoor Space/Bike storage/ Plenty of guest Parkings
* One Large assigned Parking; bike locker
* Maximum to 2 small-medium well-behaved pets
* Contract: At Least One Year Lease

*Available: August 1, 2026

* Location: 2477 Waterloo street, Vancouver

**CREDIT CHECK WILL BE DONE**
